title: Why some QR codes stop working after a free trial
description: Understand static codes, dynamic redirects, and trial expiry. Check a code before printing and learn what you can do if an existing code stops working.

title: QR code stopped working? How to find the cause and fix it
description: Scan it and look at what opens. Find out if the print, your website, or the QR company's redirect failed, and which fixes need a reprint.

title: What happens to your QR codes when you cancel? What 8 QR companies say
description: Whether your printed codes keep working after a trial ends or you cancel depends on the company. Their own policies side by side, with sources.

title: Paid $1 for a QR code, then charged again? How QR trial subscriptions work
description: That $1 QR code was likely a 7-day trial that renews. How to cancel, ask for a refund, and what happens to the code you already printed.
